reproducibility_frictions_observed: pip install -e . of the repo fails: setup.py imports pkg_resources, absent in the modern isolated build backend (setuptools) — editable install impossible without patching; worked around by importing the source tree directly

human_eval/execution.py as shipped is syntactically invalid (exec line commented out leaves an empty with-block) — deliberate safety gate, but every reproducer must modify code before evaluation can run; helpers re-implemented in harness/heb_eval.py
Original generation used API default temperature (1.0) with no seed — sampling variance is inherent; comparisons use bootstrap CIs over tasks
Original per-sample results are archived in the repo (data/*_results.jsonl), enabling task-level comparison — an L1-compliant paper
